web.title: Xsight Labs Announces X2 - Xsight Labs
web.description: Xsight Labs unveils the X2 — a 5nm, 12.8 Tbps fully programmable SDN switch at 200W with 40% lower power and UEC support for AI and hyperscale networks.
snippets: Xsight Labs, a fabless semiconductor company delivering end-to-end connectivity solutions for next-generation AI Factory, Traditional hyperscale IaaS, Next Generation Edge and private data center networks, today announced the availability of the X2, the second-generation X-Switch family of fully programmable SDN Ethernet switches.

Moreover, the commitment of the Xsight Labs team to a crisp, documented hardware/software interface allows us to better build the compiler, tooling and system software at the heart of the cloud computer. We have said that switching silicon is awaiting its ‘x86 moment’: a committed instruction set that allows for not just a world-beating chip but also unlocks open systems software innovation.
X2 is sampling to customers now. Please contact saleswebform@xsightlabs.com for more information.

“Xsight Labs is proud to unveil X2, an ultra-low-power, fully programmable SDN data center switch,” said Yossi Meyouhas, Xsight Labs CEO. “The X2 is optimized for cloud networks transitioning to native 100G SerDes connectivity to the host and 800G optics to the fabric.

snippets: Xsight Labs is positioned to capture growth in AI-driven data centers with its X2 and X-PND innovations, likely expanding its portfolio to support emerging 1.6T+ standards and deeper software integration.[3] Trends like AI model scaling, edge computing proliferation, and sustainability mandates will propel demand for its efficiency-focused connectivity, evolving its role from challenger to key enabler in hyperscale architectures.

The company builds a broad portfolio including the X2 programmable Ethernet switch—featuring 100G PAM4 LR SerDes for in-rack DAC connectivity without retimers and compatibility with 800G optics—and the X-PND™ Engine for unconditional resource elasticity, dynamic scalability, and wire-speed in-cast performance to handle microbursts.[3] It serves hyperscalers, AI providers, and 5G/compute infrastructure operators, solving challenges like bandwidth growth, resource inefficiency, and network stability in AI-driven environments.[1][2][3]
Xsight Labs is a technology company.

Programmable Ethernet Switching (X2): Second-generation switch with industry-leading 100G PAM4 LR SerDes, enabling retimer-free DAC connectivity for 100G ecosystems and future-proofing for 800G optics, optimizing power and performance.[3]

Xsight Labs is a series D company based in Kiryat Gat (Israel), founded in 2017 by Guy Koren, Erez Shaizaf and Gal Malach. It operates as a Provider of data center switches for Ethernet connectivity. Xsight Labs has raised $216M in funding from investors like Intel Capital, Valor Equity Partners and Atreides Management.

web.description: The Kiryat Gat-based company, of which Avigdor Willenz was a founding investor and where he serves as chairperson, is valued at $2.5 billion.
snippets: Kiryat Gat-based Xsight Labs, in which Willenz was a founding investor and serves as chairperson, is raising $300 million at a valuation of $2.5 billion, following its success in signing up several new customers, the most prominent of them being Starlink, a subsidiary of SpaceX, newly floated on Nasdaq.
Xsight Labs specializes in network chips designed to accelerate cloud and AI processing in data centers, and thus partly competes with Mellanox, which was acquired by Nvidia seven years ago.

web.title: Xsight Labs Closes Series D Funding - Xsight Labs
web.description: Xsight Labs closes an oversubscribed Series D led by Valor and Atreides, with Fidelity joining, to scale R&D and accelerate its cloud connectivity roadmap.
snippets: Xsight Labs emerged from stealth in December 2020 and announced the sampling availability of X1, the industry’s first 25.6T data center switch with 100G PAM4 SerDes.

“I would like to welcome Fidelity Management & Research Company to the Xsight Labs family and thank all of our investors for their continued support, especially Valor and Atreides for their leading efforts. With this new investment, we are poised to ramp up the X1 family of data center switches and drive exciting new additions to our roadmap,” said Guy Koren, Co-Founder and CEO of Xsight Labs.

Xsight Labs, a fabless semiconductor startup company, today announced the closing of its Series D funding. The round was led by Valor Equity Partners and Atreides Management and was joined by new investor Fidelity Management & Research Company. Existing investors Battery Ventures, Intel Capital, M12 Microsoft’s Venture Fund and Xilinx, increased their investments.
“Xsight Labs’ Series D was significantly oversubscribed and is the largest round ever raised by our group,” said Avigdor Willenz, Xsight Labs’ founding investor.
